description: Controller feedback: the git commit path has gotten overengineered and takes too long. Observed cost on 2026-10-13: a routine session-end commit required spawning a Rigby subagent (persona load + skills/git/SKILL.md read), the ies-git wrapper with --ack-gated flags, git-gate eval-wrapping hooks (which also break on multi-line commit messages), multiple sequential commits because eval/harness files churn during the pass, and a Ralph verification pass on top — minutes of wall-clock and tens of thousands of tokens for what is functionally 'stage everything and commit'.
correction: Routine session commits should be fast. The full ceremony (gates, eval wrapping, verification) is justified only for high-stakes operations: evolutions, gated-directory capability changes, or pushes. A plain session-end commit of memory/data/eval churn does not need it.
systemic_fix: Proposed for Rigby design pass: (1) add a fast path to skills/git/SKILL.md for routine session commits — direct ies-git stage+commit with a standard message, no per-commit eval wrapping, no Ralph verification; (2) reserve the full gate path (--ack-gated, eval wrapping, verification) for gated-dir changes, evolutions, and pushes; (3) fix the git-gate hook's multi-line message quoting bug in the same pass; (4) consider one commit per pass instead of chasing churn with sequential commits — commit once, leave post-commit harness churn for the next session.
fix_applied: 2026-10-13: risk-classified git commit paths implemented per approved design. (1) Deterministic path classifier in skills/git/scripts/commit_classifier.py: Class A routine (memory/, data/, reviews/, meetings/, decisions/, people/, delegations/, projects/, carve-outs systems/eval-harness/runs/ + systems/error-tracking/entries/ + systems/eval-harness/git-ops.jsonl), Class B gated (workflows/, skills/, agents/, .claude/, rest of systems/), Class C push unchanged. Any non-A path structurally refuses the fast lane (exit 4). (2) New ies-git session-commit verb: one add -A + one commit, standard message, no --ack-gated ceremony, no per-commit eval wrapping, no Ralph. (3) Pre-flight pattern blocker (exit 8: meetings/**/*.html, .DS_Store, .fuse_hidden*, .~lock.*#, stray root/meetings temp scripts, __pycache__; exit 9: media deletions from Class A folders) replaces post-hoc verification for Class A; Ralph remains for Class B/evolutions/pushes. (4) One commit per class; post-commit harness churn waits for next session. (5) git-gate.py multi-line -m quoting bug fixed (full-command rewrite when extra lines are inside quotes). Documented in skills/git/SKILL.md (Commit Risk Classes + session-commit + minimal spawn pattern). Logged as pending evolution work-20261013-git-commit-risk-classes. Verified: classifier unit tests pass, both lanes dry-run tested, no junk commits on main.
